completion_code:
if self.completionHandled then
        return
    end
    self.completionHandled = true

    if not self.ads:isInterstitialReady() then
        self.gameplay:showResults()
        return
    end

    self.isShowing = true
    self.gameplay:pause()

    local resolved = false
    local function finish()
        if resolved then
            return
        end
        resolved = true
        self.isShowing = false
        self.gameplay:showResults()
    end

    local ok, accepted = pcall(function()
        return self.ads:showInterstitial({
            onClosed = finish,
            onFailed = finish,
        })
    end)

    if not ok or not accepted then
        finish()
    end
end
callback_handling: A shared guarded completion callback handles dismissal and display failure. The guard also makes a synchronous callback safe if the SDK subsequently reports that the request was not accepted.
invocation_timing: Call this handler once when the level ends. Check readiness before pausing gameplay; pause only while a ready interstitial is being presented, then transition to the results screen when it closes or fails.
completion_instruction: Complete the level-completion handler so it shows an interstitial only when one is ready, pauses gameplay while it is displayed, and opens the results screen after dismissal or failure. Ensure the completion is handled only once and that a failed or rejected show request cannot leave gameplay paused.
reward_state_transition: This interstitial grants no gameplay reward. Level completion is recorded once, and all paths proceed to the results screen without changing the player's inventory or currency.
